item_taken: index 3 (0-based; fourth item): 'The missing tooth: a newly visible' — the grid of twenty-seven cells with twenty-six full made the one empty pool palpable, and Hanne Rask pointed at it and described its occupant from its full neighbours on 11 January 2021, five months before the flounder was seined on 14 June 2021; this is pointing at what ought to be there before finding it. Not 'The grain turns' (no change of scale turned texture into pattern; the grid was laid at one scale in March 2019), not 'Door-shaped error' (the empty cell was never an exception to a rule that then became access to the rule's conditions; it was an absence the arrangement predicted and the catch confirmed), and not 'Orchard in a rule' (the delight is the palpable absence at one address, not an understanding producing unfamiliar cases in general).
reasoning: The rule divides one shock by its reading: kept here if it opens the search, enumeration-stalls' if it is read as the reason the enumerator closes the notebook one member into the region the shock opened. The case's own facts fix the reading. The shock was 'The sea comes up the Vael' (14 June 2021), which opened a region: marine fishes ascending the river. The enumerator admitted exactly one member of that region, the flounder, 'last admitted and the only marine one', and the report of October 2021 then gave every cell an occupant and closed 'the fauna of the Vael, spring to tide, is complete', not sampling the two kilometres below the weir. The flounder filled the twenty-seventh cell and was the salt-tolerant end the plan's last line had ordered, so the catch that opened the marine region was read as the axis's tide end reached, and the notebook closed on it. That is one member into the region the shock opened. The 2024 second team's six marine species at the weir pool and the reach below, none in her list, show the universe was not exhausted. The rule decides: the shock ended the search. The case already declares that the closing at the weir is the stall it carries, so the rule does not have to be read against the case's grain.
case_out: A mechanism by which an enumeration stops yielding new members before its universe is exhausted while feeling complete: Hanne Rask, a freshwater ecologist surveying the fishes of the river Vael from 2019 to 2021, laid the survey in March 2019 on one named axis, 'from the spring to the tide', nine reaches from the spring at Kell to the tidal weir at Orm, folded into three rows by habitat, riffle, pool, and backwater, twenty-seven cells each to be netted, with the plan's last line ordering the salt-tolerant end of every row at reach nine. By the close of the 2020 season twenty-six cells held at least one species and one was empty, the pool of the ninth reach, the last above the weir, with full neighbours on three sides: the ninth reach's riffle holding the three-spined stickleback, the ninth reach's backwater holding the eel, and the pool column running reach by reach from trout through grayling and chub to the bream and roach of the eighth reach, stiller and warmer at every step. On 11 January 2021 she pointed at the empty cell and described its occupant from its neighbours, writing 'Reach 9 pool. Something lives here. Bottom-living, still water, takes the salt that comes up on spring tides: a flounder, or a goby. Look at low water in June.' On 14 June 2021, seining the ninth-reach pool at low water, she took three juvenile flounder, a marine flatfish that ascends rivers, and wrote that evening, 'The sea comes up the Vael.' The stall is what happened to that shock: it was read as the axis's tide end reached, the salt-tolerant end the plan's last line had ordered for every row, rather than as the opening of a region of marine fishes ascending the river, and the enumerator closed the notebook one member into that region. Her final report of October 2021 lists thirty species, the flounder last admitted and the only marine one, gives every one of the twenty-seven cells an occupant, and closes, the fauna of the Vael, spring to tide, is complete. The stall is made of the axis's endpoints: the same axis whose tide end yielded the flounder closed the walk at the weir. The tell that separates it from exhaustion is in the case's facts: below the weir the river runs two further kilometres to the sea, which the report does not sample, and the one marine species admitted stands alone in a list of thirty. Who read the tell and the move that restarted the enumeration are one fact in the case: in 2024 a second team netting the weir pool and the reach below it took mullet, bass, smelt, sand goby, sprat, and sand smelt, six marine species, none in her list, found by netting and not preceded by any pointing. The following travel with the case as its own and are not the item here: the recognition shock itself, that the pointing preceded the catch by five months, that the description was drawn from the three full neighbours and the pool column, and that the empty cell was palpable before it was filled, which is the delight the sending map keeps; and the mechanism that made the pointing precise, the address and description the full neighbours fixed, which stays on form-yields.
